name: exact-history-and-object-hashes
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,subprocess,sys,hashlib,base64
p=Path.cwd()
def write(n,o):
 s=o if isinstance(o,str) else json.dumps(o,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert z.returncode==0
d=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text())
for v in d['records'].values():
 b=base64.b64decode(v['raw_base64']);v['object_original_bytes_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(b.rstrip(b'\r\n')).hexdigest();v['object_canonical_json_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v['object'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
write('raw-provenance.json',d)
ids=list(d['records']); terms=[r['object']['source_url'].rsplit('/',1)[1] for r in d['records'].values()]+['strongly pigeonhole','degree-and-type','balanced diagonal','type-2 zero','shortest cycle cover','freeness defect','polytope translation','generically 4-transitive']
allow=json.loads((p/'historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); hits=[]
for s in allow:
 if re.search(r'crown|tournament|bunkbed|hat-bipartite-cycle-formal-pi-r2|polynexus-rook-formal-pi-r2|protected',s,re.I):continue
 try:t=Path(s).read_text()
 except OSError:continue
 ts=[v for v in terms if v.lower() in t.lower()]
 exact=[i for i in ids if re.search(r'(?<![a-zA-Z0-9])'+i+r'(?![a-zA-Z0-9])',t)]
 if exact or ts:
  hits.append({'path':s,'exact_id_tokens':exact,'source_or_family_terms':ts,'matching_lines':[l for l in t.splitlines() if any(v.lower() in l.lower() for v in ts)][:16]})
write('history-reconciliation.json',{'scope':'exact allowlist only; protected-name filter before open; no embedded paths followed','hits':hits,'warning':'Original substring matches inside hexadecimal hashes are not ID matches. No exact match is not novelty clearance.'})
print(json.dumps(hits,indent=2))
